metadata.explanation: Wait, bounded, for the provisioning's report, then read its outcome from the provisioning and record the instance ready or failed.
Wait for the next command of the Session, then record which instance it provisions or reclaims; a provisioning first reclaims an instance whose Pod may still run.
Complete the workspace of a deleting Project, discarding pending commands; the deletion releases the instance's resources by label.
Start the SandboxProvisionFlow of the request's instance on the volume earlier instances left.

Wait for a provisioning that may still run, have a Preview that holds the instance release it, stop the Preview engine, record the workspace and delete the Pod, keeping the volume; then provision the request that waited for it.
Record a request whose provisioning was rejected, exhausted its retries or reported nothing in time, keeping the instance provisioning, and report the failure.
Record a reclamation that did not finish, keeping the instance's resources, and fail the request that waited for the volume.
Record a report whose retries ran out as undelivered and wait for the next command; the Session reads the outcome once its own wait ends.
Report the outcome to the Session and record its answer; an instance the Session declined is reclaimed, and an undelivered report waits for the Session's own bounded wait.

fields.description: Outcome of the last command and how the Session answered it
